description: Fetch one public web page and return its readable content as compact Markdown (links and tables kept) plus title, meta description, language, canonical URL, OpenGraph/Twitter tags, JSON-LD structured data (products, articles, organisations, events), mailto emails and tel phone numbers. Use to read or summarise a page or pull its schema.org data. No JavaScript rendering.
name: extract_page
title: Web page to Markdown + metadata (JSON-LD, OpenGraph)
